describes: packages/plugin/page-edit: PON-addressed page edits over the engine handle.

cases.name: can-edit
cases.covers: canEdit() is the doc.pages.assemble authority, wildcard included; it is the one twin for every structure verb.

cases.name: rotate-by
cases.covers: rotateBy turns a relative turn into the absolute wire from the registry rotation, wrapping into [0, 360); an unknown pon counts as 0; any number is carried through the arithmetic.

cases.name: rotate-by-follows-the-registry
cases.covers: After a pages.rotated event replaces the registry, rotateBy starts from the new rotation.

cases.name: passthroughs
cases.covers: setRotation, move and delete forward their arguments unchanged and return the engine promise, which settles with the engine answer.

cases.name: refused-by-the-engine
cases.covers: Without doc.pages.assemble canEdit() is false, and every verb still calls the engine, whose PermissionDenied rejects the returned promise with its full shape.

cases.name: deferred-and-aborted
cases.covers: A deferred edit settles when the engine answers, and the verbs run one at a time: the delete reaches the engine only after the rotate settles.

cases.name: add-blank
cases.covers: addBlank: append by default sized like the last page; PON placements land after/before the anchor sized like it; an index placement is forwarded verbatim and sized like its predecessor, clamped into the registry; explicit size and count win; a missing anchor throws.

cases.name: add-blank-fractional-index
cases.covers: An index placement that is not an integer (or NaN) makes the predecessor lookup read a page that does not exist, which throws the TypeError the TypeScript throws; an explicit size skips the lookup.

cases.name: insert
cases.covers: insert forwards the bytes and the resolved placement index; a missing anchor throws before any engine call.

cases.name: a-captured-capability-outlives-its-document
cases.covers: A capability captured before its document closed keeps its handle and the last registry it saw: the verbs still reach the engine (the kernel no longer resolves the capability).

cases.name: an-empty-registry
cases.covers: A document with no pages: rotation reads as 0, a PON anchor is not found, and a blank page defaults to US Letter wherever it goes.

cases.name: state-and-scope
cases.covers: The plugin keeps an empty slice per document and has no capability before a document opens.
